commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+8' A neat pass is well received by Darwin Nunez (Liverpool), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball on goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
90+6' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
90+6' James Maddison (Tottenham) sends the corner into the box, but Alisson intercepts it and averts the threat.
90+5' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
90+4' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) passes the ball onto Cody Gakpo, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.

90+4' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) attempts to release Richarlison with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players. The ball is behind the touchline and Tottenham will take a throw-in.
90+3' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
90+3' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
90+2' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) receives a yellow card from the referee, but it seems like a very harsh decision.
90+2' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender.
90+1' Tottenham take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
90' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
90' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) timed his run perfectly to connect with the resulting corner kick, but his finish from around the penalty spot was rather poor as it went well wide of the right post.
89' The referee blows his whistle, Liverpool are awarded a corner kick.
89' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Mohamed Salah (Liverpool).
87' Richarlison (Tottenham) is the one to unleash a good effort towards the bottom right corner. His shot, however, is saved by the goalkeeper. What a save!
87' Chance! Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) comes within inches of scoring after picking up a pass from Mohamed Salah, but his shot from inside the box flashes inches wide of the right post.
85' The ball is laid off to Giovani Lo Celso (Tottenham) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players low towards the middle of the goal and forces Alisson to make a decent save.
83' The game has come to an end for Harvey Elliott. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool).
83' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) moves forward and unleashes a thunderous shot from distance that flies well over the bar.
82' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) offside.
81' Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Brennan Johnson, but Alisson displays great awareness to stop him.

81' What a miss! Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) is left standing right in front of goal with only the keeper to beat after a clever pass, but he somehow contrives to toe poke the ball just past the right post.
80' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
79' Paul Tierney sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
78' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Tottenham players aren’t happy.

77' 4 - 2 Goal! Richarlison plays in Heung-Min Son (Tottenham), who shows great determination to get to the ball before a couple of defenders and from inside the box slots it into the bottom left corner 4:2.
76' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
76' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
75' Here's the change. Pape Matar Sarr leaves the pitch and Giovani Lo Celso (Tottenham) comes on as a substitute.
75' Here is a change. Alexis Mac Allister is going off and Jurgen Klopp gives the last tactical orders to Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool).
75' Luis Diaz will be replaced by Darwin Nunez (Liverpool).
74' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) makes a rough challenge and Paul Tierney blows his whistle for a foul.
74' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
72' 4 - 1 Goal! Richarlison (Tottenham) scores after an assist by Brennan Johnson that allowed him to tap in the ball into an empty net. The score is 4:1.
72' Guglielmo Vicario blocks Harvey Elliott (Liverpool)'s effort from the edge of the box.
71' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
70' James Maddison (Tottenham) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play.
69' Poor challenge! Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) is penalised for tripping and Paul Tierney blows his whistle.
69' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Heung-Min Son (Tottenham).
66' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) trips an opposition player and Paul Tierney signals a foul.
66' James Maddison (Tottenham) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar.
64' Jurgen Klopp prepares a substitution. Wataru Endo is replaced by Stefan Bajcetic (Liverpool).
64' A substitution has been made. Andrew Robertson goes off and Joe Gomez (Liverpool) comes on.
63' Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) goes into the book for bad language. His vulgar comments could have made it worse. Luckily for him, it's a yellow card.
63' Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Paul Tierney saw the whole situation.
63' James Maddison (Tottenham) smashes the ball from the mid-range free-kick straight into the defensive wall.
61' We are about to witness a substitution. Oliver Skipp (Tottenham) is replacing Emerson Royal.
61' Ange Postecoglou has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Richarlison (Tottenham) replacing Rodrigo Bentancur.
61' James Maddison (Tottenham) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Dejan Kulusevski.
59' 4 - 0 Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) produces a moment of pure magic and scores a spectacular goal by striking the ball into the top left corner of the net!
59' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
58' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
57' Emerson Royal (Tottenham) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
57' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) jumps into a tackle and Paul Tierney signals a foul.
56' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
55' Alisson pulls off a fine save! Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header low towards the middle, but the effort is kept out.
53' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
53' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Mohamed Salah (Liverpool). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
51' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) is thwarted and cleared to safety. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Tottenham.

50' 3 - 0 Harvey Elliott produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box, where Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) rises high to head the ball into the left side of the goal and beyond the goalkeeper. He makes it 3:0.
49' Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
48' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
47' What was Micky van de Ven (Tottenham) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.

47' What a wasted opportunity by Mohamed Salah (Liverpool)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the middle of the net, but Guglielmo Vicario makes a comfortable save to thwart him.
46' The whistle blows and Paul Tierney starts the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
45+2' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Paul Tierney blows his whistle for a foul.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' 2 - 0 Goal! Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 2:0.

45' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the right side of the goal, but Guglielmo Vicario is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
44' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
43' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) drills in an effort from the edge of the box that climbs rapidly and goes high over the bar.
42' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
41' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) looks furious with himself after spurning a great chance. He pounces on the rebound around the penalty spot and drags a shot well wide of the right post.
41' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
40' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
39' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
38' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Guglielmo Vicario is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
37' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
36' Mohamed Salah almost gets into in a promising position, but the through ball by Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) from just inside the box is intercepted by one of the defending players.
35' The ball is cleared after Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
34' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
34' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
33' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
33' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
32' 4:0 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
31' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) sends it out of play.
30' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) plants a nice towering header goalwards, but one of the defenders is in the right place at the right time and makes a vital clearance.
29' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
28' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Alisson comes off the line to clear the ball away.
27' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
26' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
24' Referee Paul Tierney sees the trip by Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
24' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.
23' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
22' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his effort to the bottom left corner is thwarted by Guglielmo Vicario.
21' The referee blows his whistle as Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) was too aggressive in his challenge.
20' Paul Tierney blows his whistle and signals a foul after Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) brought his opponent down.

19' Luis Diaz almost found himself in a promising position after Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) tried to send a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defenders reacts well and makes a timely interception.
19' Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Alisson, who smothers the ball.
18' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play. Tottenham will have a throw-in.

16' 1 - 0 Cody Gakpo produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box, where Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) rises high to head the ball into the right side of the goal and beyond the goalkeeper. He makes it 1:0.

15' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball is out of play. Liverpool will take a throw-in.
14' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
14' Liverpool take a short corner kick.
14' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
12' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
12' Paul Tierney has a clear sight and sees a foul from Wataru Endo (Liverpool).
11' Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Alisson comes off the line to clear the ball away.
10' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.

10' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick low strike towards the middle of the goal that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a superb goal-line clearance.
10' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) decided to shoot after receiving a sweet pass. If it wasn't for Guglielmo Vicario's superb save the ball would have probably ended up in the bottom right corner.
9' Liverpool have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
8' It should have been a goal! Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) fires a rocket of a shot but it only hits the crossbar!
7' Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
6' Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
5' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Guglielmo Vicario intercepts the ball.
4' Emerson Royal (Tottenham) makes a strong challenge and Paul Tierney blows for a foul.
4' Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar.
3' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) fails to deliver a cross from the free kick as his attempt is thwarted by the opposition's defence.
3' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Paul Tierney signals.
2' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
2' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Tottenham earn a corner.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Tottenham will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Paul Tierney.
